verdict_reason: CLMS SWF (open, EU-wide, attribution-only) and Sentinel-2 SR (open, GEE catalog) fetched and verified, no application needed. Crux: only 3 sparse epochs (2015/2018/2021) exist, not annual; no register of newly-planted-hedgerow locations found, so 'new planting' ground truth must be constructed via SWF epoch-differencing plus manual orthophoto spot-checks.
